comment: MAC confirmed on the router 2026-09-11 (DHCP lease, hostname XBOX, Microsoft OUI d8:e2:df). The firewall rule matches on the MAC, so it covers IPv6 and survives the IP changing; the IPv4 is still used for the inbound byte counter and for conntrack flushing. A static DHCP reservation already exists at dhcp.@host[1].

router._comment: ubus_path_candidates was trimmed to the one path that answers: /cgi-bin/luci/rpc/ubus is luci-mod-rpc, a different API, and 404s here. tls_sha256 is set by './xbox.py pin'.

state._comment: 'up' means the console's outbound byte rate exceeded threshold_bytes_per_min since the previous sample. Calibrate against the real console with './xbox.py calibrate' — see F-06.md. A sample older than max_sample_age_s is discarded as stale and reported as 'unknown' rather than averaged over the gap.

rules.description: Firewall uci sections named kidsout_xbox* belong to kidsout. block/allow only toggle their 'enabled' option: enabled=1 means the REJECT rule is in force (internet blocked), enabled=0 means it is absent (internet allowed). Nothing else on the router is touched.
